answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity bond that is slashed, not merely staked: to field N fake agents an attacker must post N separate locked deposits that are forfeited on detection. The economics are a fable of sunk cost, since dependability pays only after long uptime, while a fresh jetty of cloned nodes earns nothing yet carries full collateral risk, and a karst of cheap identities drains capital faster than any payout.
